text:
The available evidence does not establish that the asset is deforestation-free.

The JRC dataset mapped no forest on the asset in 2020, the assessment’s baseline year. Hansen data mapped 34.5 hectares of tree cover in 2000, but the output does not report whether or when that cover was lost.

Hansen data coverage is complete through 2025, but no loss-event results are provided. A deforestation-free conclusion would require those results or further verification.
